description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for handling user registration requests, containing fields for email, password, and full name, with appropriate validation annotations and accessors.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: A DTO class for capturing registration request data, including email, password, and full name, with validation and schema annotations.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address provided in the registration request.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password provided in the registration request.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name provided in the registration request.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address for the registration request.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for the registration request.

methods.name: setFullName
methods.description: Sets the full name for the registration request.
